sample_unit: ChatGPT-generated patient education texts (one per dermatological disease)

links.outcome: Flesch reading ease of ChatGPT-generated patient education text
links.effect: Mean reading ease 46.94 ± 8.23 (P < 0.0001 vs 30), which the authors interpret as understandable by high-school to early college students; a level that may exceed the reading level of many patients.
links.quote: The average text reading ease score was 46.94 ± 8.23 (P < 0.0001), and it indicates that this level of text can easily be understood by a high-school student to a newly joined college student.

unlisted_practices: Checking AI-generated text for similarity/plagiarism (text similarity index 27.07% vs 15% limit) before use

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials for dermatology, assessing readability, accuracy (SOLO taxonomy), and text similarity without testing an active deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
